item.title: ABB Launches Automation Extended to Modernize Legacy DCS
item.description: This release enables the modernization of existing distributed control systems without disrupting operations by keeping core control and digital environments connected yet securely separated.

item.title: Manufacturer Revives De-Commissioned System to Advance Production
item.description: Dormant since 2013, a seal-coating system at a pharma manufacturing company returned to use in production through intelligent automation upgrades, proving sustainability, cost-efficiency and digital transformation can coexist in manufacturing.

item.title: ETM Begins Licensing Its Transverse Flux Motor Technology
item.description: This new business model will allow OEMs to license the motor technology to manufacture it within their own platforms.

item.title: How to Integrate Decades-Old Modbus Devices Without Regret
item.description: The mistake in 2026 isn’t using Modbus, it’s integrating it incorrectly. Success comes from isolating your Modbus networks, choosing the right integration device, contextualizing data and avoiding misuse in control or enterprise applications.

item.title: Phoenix Contact Launches Technology Alliance Program
item.description: The program has been developed to extend the company’s industrial switch and computing platform technologies through interoperability with outside applications.

item.title: Will 2026 Be the Year AI Moves from Possibility to Production in Manufacturing?
item.description: AI agents are transforming manufacturing beyond experimentation. Discover how industry leaders are rebuilding digital infrastructure to unlock lasting operational value.

item.title: HighRes and Opentrons Create AI Agent-to-Agent Workflow
item.description: This new laboratory workflow aims to combine both companies’ technologies to deliver AI-ready automation that can scale with expanding lab ecosystems.

item.title: How Automation Addresses Industry’s Worker Shortage While Improving Safety and Job Satisfaction
item.description: Collaborative robots and other automation technologies are reshaping manufacturing roles, primarily to reduce safety hazards but they’re also helping make the industry more appealing to younger workers.

item.title: How Software Differentiation Strategies Help Industrial OEMs Escape the Hardware Complexity Trap
item.description: In this episode, we connect with Dale Hopkinson, senior product manager with Thales, a supplier of technologies for the aerospace, defense and security industry and a provider of cybersecurity and digital identity technologies, to learn how OEMs are leveraging modular software licensing to replace costly hardware variants, creating predictable revenue while delivering customizable capabilities to industrial customers.

item.title: Test Your Knowledge: Why Manufacturing AI Pilots Stall
item.description: Fragmented data, IT/OT disconnects and other reasons manufacturing AI pilots fail to scale.
